item.title: The Ghosts Who Haunt The Comedy Store
item.description: The Comedy Store in Los Angeles opened in 1972 and soon became a mecca for those hoping to break into the big time in standup comedy. The nightclub became famous for incubating the careers of some of the biggest comedians of the last 50 years. Of course, there have been plenty of comedians who graced the stage at The Comedy Store or else waited tables and never made it big. item.title: How Humans Built an Extraordinary Bond with Dogs
item.description: Nearly all domestic dogs are descended from the Eurasian gray wolf (Canis lupus). They first became pets long before we domesticated farm animals or developed agriculture or the written word, so we don't know where or when it happened. However, it only makes sense that the wolves who were the least fearful of humans got close enough to eat our leftovers. item.title: Hospital Evacuated after World War I Artillery Shell Found in Patient's Rectum
item.description: The Western Front of World War I concentrated its devastation in certain parts of France, Belgium, Luxembourg, and Germany. item.title: "His Shadow Creeps" is a Groundhog Day Anthem
item.description: Happy Groundhog Day, everyone! I hope the weather is overcast where you are, so the local groundhog won't see his shadow and be scared back into his den for six more weeks. First, there was only the traditional folklore about a groundhog emerging from its hibernation. Then we got Punxsutawney Phil, who somehow became THE groundhog people were talking about on February second. item.description: In case you haven't been keeping up, 2026 is the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence, which preceded most of the Revolutionary War but is designated as the milestone that marks beginning of the United States of America. item.title: Rare Disease Keeps Cat From Growing
item.description: Grub is not a normal cat. He has a genetic disorder that's quite rare in cats, so rare that medical specialists are studying him to learn about it. You might imagine that it's less rare than they know, because most cats with mucopolysaccharidosis wouldn't survive long enough to be properly diagnosed.Stephanie took Grub in as a foster cat through the rescue organization Good Mews in Georgia. item.title: The Last Soldier of the French and Indian War May Also Be the Oldest Photo Subject
item.description: A few years ago, we posted some contenders for the earliest-born person to be photographed. item.title: The Clever Way K-Pop Makes Two Languages Cool
item.description: K-Pop music arose in the 1990s, but you probably didn't know that because it was in Korea, and it was sung in the Korean language. Still, the music was inspired by the American pop scene, so occasionally, song producers would sprinkle in some English terms to make a song more "cool." A few more English terms, plus American soldiers rotating in and out of South Korea, and K-Pop started gaining a foothold in the US.
